authority: Attached task, manuscript II-VIII and agreed clarifications; existing R-018..021, R-030/R-033 and recovery contracts

ownership.manager: permanent allocation, exact issuer/issue/state reservation, current state/history, own head/generation
ownership.issuer: approved intent, recipient, challenge/nonce, signing claim, certification and exact outcome, own head/generation
ownership.holder: secret/intent and atomic in-memory accepted credential/witness

transaction: Separate unchanged SQLite databases. Intent -> reservation -> attachment -> pending -> claim -> certification -> recipient publication. No distributed transaction or compensation.
freshness: ManagerIssuancePort uses an admitted current snapshot for final registered witness, never the earlier reservation. Changes before read reject; later changes do not retroactively invalidate original issuance checkpoint.
recovery: Explicit independently retained head for each service; retire incomplete INTENT/RESERVED/SIGNING, preserve complete PENDING/CERTIFIED per existing reconcile; unavailable/mismatched manager evidence rejects.
proof: Normal None remains UnsupportedEnrolmentVerifier; exact synthetic statement/token verifier injected only by test helpers; not real proof or anonymous-authentication evidence.
publication: Durable exact credential result before current-writer, exact-head, original-recipient socket enqueue. Redelivery signs/allocates zero times; HolderAcceptance checks and atomic pointer preserved.
fault_model: 22 integration cases, including simulated exceptions, plus two actual owned-process SIGKILL cases after reservation/certification commit. Coordinator retains both exact heads. No power-loss or rollback claim.
